title: Certified Road Events — World Athletics
claims: Certified road events hold a valid International Course Measurement Certificate issued by an approved measurer; the certificate is valid for five years.
Certification checks the start–finish separation and the allowed elevation drop over the course, alongside the measuring procedure itself.
Race results used for entry or qualification must come from a course whose certification is in force; an expired or missing certificate invalidates the result for that purpose.
